- brief.md: around, or one person pays and everyone settles roughly ("just send me 40"). [ASSUMED]
- brief.md: month. Nobody else has to open it: they just get told their share. [ASSUMED]
- brief.md: Tip % input with quick picks (10, 15, 18, 20) plus a custom % · must-have · 18% picked by default (D-6). Custom allows 0–100% with decimals. Quick picks are [ASSUMED]
- brief.md: Results: tip amount, total, amount per person · must-have · Updates live, no "calculate" button [ASSUMED]. Shows a placeholder until the bill is valid, never $0.00 or NaN (D-6)
- brief.md: Saving past bills / history · later · Nothing to save in v1 [ASSUMED]
- brief.md: Tax handled separately from tip · later · v1 tips on whatever amount is entered [ASSUMED]
- brief.md: None stored. Every number lives on the screen and is gone on reload. No backend, no API. [ASSUMED]
- brief.md: English only, WCAG 2.2 AA. [ASSUMED]
- brief.md: No analytics, no personal data. [ASSUMED]
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T1 Problem: tip math plus dividing at the table is slow and error-prone; today people use a phone calculator or settle roughly (the usual reason a splitter beats a calculator)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T2 Who: the person sorting out the bill, on their phone, a few times a month (it's used at the table)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T3 Success: shares show live, and add up to at least the total (nobody's short)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T4 Platforms: web, responsive down to a phone (works everywhere; no install)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T5 Tip quick picks 10/15/18/20 plus custom (one tap beats typing)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T5 Tip is calculated on the amount entered; no separate tax line (keeps v1 to 3 inputs)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T6 Data: nothing saved, nothing sent anywhere (v1 has nothing worth keeping; this differs from the fwos default of local saving)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T8 Design system: the neutral starter, light and dark (passes contrast; swap in a brand any time)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] Rounding rule: each share is rounded up to the next cent (nobody's short). Showing the overage is decided (D-6); the rule itself is still assumed
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] The tip amount itself rounds to the nearest cent, half up (the usual convention)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T10 Integrations: none (each one adds a backend)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T11 Constraints: no deadline or required tech
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T12 Privacy: no personal data, no analytics (nothing to consent to)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T13 English only, WCAG 2.2 AA (the common legal bar)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T14 Hosting: any static host, picked at release (fwos never deploys)
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T15 Identity: name "Tip Splitter", no icon yet
- brief.md: [ASSUMED] T16 Browsers: last 2 versions of evergreen browsers
